arguments.code:
# Fix: replace html.unescape with unescape from toc module for slugify
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(
    ['cat', 'markdown/extensions/toc.py'],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
content = result.stdout

old_line = '''                if "id" not in el.attrib:
                    import sys
                    print(f"DEBUG: text={repr(text)}", file=sys.stderr)
                    print(f"DEBUG: unescaped={repr(html.unescape(text))}", file=sys.stderr)
                    print(f"DEBUG: chars={[ord(c) for c in text]}", file=sys.stderr)
                    el.attrib["id"] = unique(self.slugify(html.unescape(text), self.sep), used_ids)
                    print(f"DEBUG: id={el.attrib['id']}", file=sys.stderr)'''

new_line = '''                if "id" not in el.attrib:
                    el.attrib["id"] = unique(self.slugify(unescape(text), self.sep), used_ids)'''

new_content = content.replace(old_line, new_line)

with open('markdown/extensions/toc.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(new_content)

print("Fixed slugify to use unescape instead of html.unescape")

# Verify
result2 = subprocess.run(
    ['sed', '-n', '340,350p', 'markdown/extensions/toc.py'],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
print(result2.stdout)
